conflict_axes.description: The deposit property that survives daily abrasion is the same property that cracks when the piece is bent, riveted or set after plating; no gold chemistry gives both at once.
poles: maximise scratch resistance with a hardened deposit
maximise ductility with a soft high-purity deposit
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: settle the forming order first, then choose hardness; form-first is the default, and any plate-then-form product line accepts and discloses reduced scratch resistance

conflict_axes.name: technical_fit_versus_hazard_obligation
conflict_axes.description: The chemistry that best suits the job is frequently the one carrying the heaviest training, storage, ventilation and licensing obligations, which a small bench may be unable to satisfy.
poles: run the family that best fits the job
run only what the shop is genuinely ready and permitted to run
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: readiness dominates: an unready family is not on the shortlist at all, and the honest options are an alternative family, an outsourced step, or declining the work

conflict_axes.name: colour_by_alloy_versus_colour_by_purity
conflict_axes.description: A tuned hue needs co-deposited metals that drift with every condition that moves, while a stable hue comes from purity and offers exactly one colour.
poles: tune the hue with alloy additions
take the stable single hue that purity gives
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let the customer's colour requirement decide, then buy the stability back with a fixed reference, a colour bath from the supplier's own system, and coupon comparison every time the bath is disturbed

conflict_axes.name: cyanide_free_compliance_relief_versus_bath_life
conflict_axes.description: Dropping cyanide removes an entire obligation class and makes a small studio viable, but the substitute chemistry is less stable, dies sooner and is far less tolerant of drag-in.
poles: minimise the compliance and hazard burden
maximise bath stability, tolerance and useful life
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let the readiness verdict decide first; where cyanide-free is chosen for compliance reasons, budget the shorter bath life and the tighter rinse discipline into the schedule rather than discovering them

conflict_axes.name: thickness_class_promised_versus_gold_committed
conflict_axes.description: Wear life is bought in microns and microns are bought in gold, so the wear class a customer wants and the gold a shop is willing to commit pull against each other on every quote.
poles: specify the thickness class the duty really needs
limit the gold committed per piece and per tank
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: never quietly downgrade the class to protect a margin; requote at the honest class, or offer the lower class with its wear expectation stated in writing before the customer agrees

conflict_axes.name: one_flexible_system_versus_dedicated_tanks
conflict_axes.description: A single well-maintained gold system is cheaper to keep honest, while dedicated strike, build and colour tanks serve more jobs properly and keep contamination out of each other.
poles: keep one system and keep it excellent
add dedicated tanks for each bath role and colour
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: add a tank only when the maintenance capacity to analyse and log it is added at the same time; otherwise decline the variety or subcontract it

conflict_axes.name: uniform_coverage_versus_thickness_ceiling
conflict_axes.description: The process class that coats complex geometry perfectly is the one whose displacement mechanism stops at a flash, while the class that builds real thickness is the one that cannot reach into the recesses.
poles: choose uniform coverage on difficult geometry
choose the thickness a wear class demands
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: split the roles across process classes where the geometry allows, and where it does not, redesign the racking or accept and disclose the flash class rather than pretending the ceiling is a tuning problem

conflict_axes.name: nickel_barrier_performance_versus_release_obligation
conflict_axes.description: Nickel is the best-performing and cheapest barrier under thin gold and is exactly the metal that skin-contact rules exist to control.
poles: keep the nickel barrier for its performance and cost
keep nickel out of any skin-contact stack
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: for skin-contact items the obligation class wins: use a non-nickel barrier class or evidence the coating integrity against current jurisdiction rules, and route the customer's health question to their clinician

conflict_axes.name: speed_to_first_part_versus_qualification_discipline
conflict_axes.description: Coupon qualification costs gold, tank time and a day the customer is already waiting for, which is exactly when the temptation to plate the real piece first is strongest.
poles: get the customer's work through the tank now
prove the system on coupons before any customer work
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: qualification dominates schedule pressure; if the deadline genuinely cannot absorb it, renegotiate the date or decline the job rather than gambling a customer's piece

conflict_axes.name: supplier_sheet_authority_versus_shop_folklore
conflict_axes.description: The product sheet governs the window while the bench carries years of remembered numbers, borrowed recipes and habits from a previous supplier's chemistry.
poles: follow the specific product's data sheet
follow accumulated bench experience and remembered numbers
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the sheet governs setpoints and compatibility; bench experience is captured in the bath log as calibration and as questions for the supplier, never as an unrecorded override of the sheet

edge_cases.description: A mixed-metal antique arrives: a silver body, a steel pin, and soft solder joints of unknown alloy, all to be gold finished as one piece.
edge_cases.trigger: an heirloom repair or restoration job where the substrate is genuinely plural and partly unidentifiable
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the piece as its most difficult constituent, plan for the strike and barrier that the worst member demands, test on the least visible area or a sacrificial equivalent, and document the heirloom risk with the customer before anything enters a tank

edge_cases.description: The customer asks for an exact colour match to an existing piece but there is no plaque, no master sample and no measurement available.
edge_cases.trigger: a repair or an addition to an existing set where the reference is the customer's own worn item
edge_cases.mitigation: make the customer's item itself the retained reference under an agreed light, plate stepped coupons to bracket the tone, and state in writing that a worn and tarnished original may not be matchable by a new deposit

edge_cases.description: The job's ductility requirement points squarely at soft cyanide gold, but the shop cannot obtain or store cyanide chemistry under its jurisdiction's arrangements.
edge_cases.trigger: a formable product line proposed in a shop whose readiness verdict excludes cyanide-bearing families
edge_cases.mitigation: move to the undoped cyanide-free family for its ductility, budget the shorter bath life honestly, or subcontract the gold step to a qualified shop; never improvise cyanide handling to close the gap

edge_cases.description: The assembly contains a non-conductive component such as a glass bead, an enamel panel or a ceramic inlay that cannot be masked off.
edge_cases.trigger: a design that mixes conductive and non-conductive materials in one piece
edge_cases.mitigation: either metallise the non-conductor first and then electroplate, or disassemble and plate the metal parts alone, or refer the piece to a coating class that suits the material; do not attempt to plate a non-conductor directly

edge_cases.description: Plate-then-form is a fixed constraint of the product design, for example continuous wire fed from a reel and formed downstream.
edge_cases.trigger: a production concept that plates stock material before forming it into finished items
edge_cases.mitigation: restrict the shortlist to ductile soft-gold families over a low-stress sulfamate-class nickel, prove survival on formed coupons at the tightest production radius, and disclose the reduced scratch resistance as part of the product specification

edge_cases.description: A skin-contact item is destined for a market with nickel-release rules and the customer rejects the cost of a palladium-class barrier.
edge_cases.trigger: a price-sensitive skin-contact line aimed at a regulated market
edge_cases.mitigation: present the compliant options and their costs, verify the current rules of the target market, and decline the non-compliant configuration rather than shipping it; route any health question to the customer's clinician

edge_cases.description: The item is a food-contact object such as a spoon, a cup rim or a serving piece rather than jewellery.
edge_cases.trigger: a customer bringing tableware or drinkware to a jewellery plating bench
edge_cases.mitigation: stop at intake: food-contact status of underplates, hardeners and residues is a separate regulatory question the corpus marks as unresolved, so verify the market's food-contact rules before quoting or decline the work

edge_cases.description: A sterling silver piece is to be finished and sold under a vermeil-class claim.
edge_cases.trigger: a wholesale or retail order whose marketing depends on a specific regulated term
edge_cases.mitigation: verify the current definition and thickness class the target market attaches to the term, confirm the substrate and the achievable coating class both satisfy it, and record the check with its date; if either fails, use a different and accurate description

edge_cases.description: The bath already standing in the shop is a different family from the one the job needs, and the schedule is tight.
edge_cases.trigger: a job arriving at a bench with one live tank and a deadline
edge_cases.mitigation: run the mismatch through the wear class and forming order rather than through convenience; if the standing bath cannot honestly serve the job, requote, subcontract, or decline, and never substitute silently

edge_cases.description: The supplier reformulates or discontinues the product the shop qualified on, and the replacement is described as equivalent.
edge_cases.trigger: a supplier notice, a changed sheet revision, or a delivery whose label differs from the qualified product
edge_cases.mitigation: treat equivalent as unproven: obtain the new sheet, re-check compatibility of strike and replenisher, re-qualify on coupons before customer work, and update the dossier with the new revision

edge_cases.description: The piece is a deeply recessed or hollow form, or a tangled chain batch, where rack plating leaves the interior visibly pale.
edge_cases.trigger: geometry whose recesses the current bath's throwing power cannot reach
edge_cases.mitigation: prove the worst geometry on a coupon before quoting, consider the current-free class for the barrier and seed layers, and where neither works, redesign the racking or state plainly that interior surfaces receive a lighter coating

edge_cases.description: A repair arrives carrying an unknown previous coating that may be rhodium, an existing gold layer, or a vacuum-deposited finish.
edge_cases.trigger: second-hand, inherited or previously refinished work entering the bench
edge_cases.mitigation: identify or strip before selecting, because plating over an unknown layer risks adhesion failure and bath contamination alike; where the existing finish is a vacuum coating, say so and refer rather than plating over it

workflow.description: Record substrate, geometry, duty, colour expectation, forming order, contact status, market and volume, marking every unverified item as unknown
workflow.gate: all profile fields are present and each unverified claim is explicitly labelled unknown rather than assumed

workflow.description: Produce a written per-family verdict covering training, storage, segregation, ventilation, protective equipment, emergency readiness and jurisdiction rules
workflow.gate: no family enters the shortlist without an available verdict, and the acid and cyanide segregation rule is reflected in the tank, storage and drain plan

workflow.action: Assign the wear class and its disclosed expectation
workflow.description: Map the item's service duty onto a wear class and write the plain-language wear expectation that goes with it
workflow.artifact: wear class assignment with customer-facing expectation
workflow.gate: the wear class and its thickness class are named as standard classes and the expectation has been disclosed before work starts

workflow.action: Fix the colour reference and its viewing conditions
workflow.description: Agree a colour class, plaque or retained master and record the light and background the comparison will happen under
workflow.gate: a physical or class-named reference exists with stated viewing conditions before any coupon is plated

workflow.action: Screen the substrate and required stack
workflow.description: Determine what strike and barrier the substrate demands and check that no electrolyte can reach bare base metal
workflow.gate: no direct-gold-on-bare-steel path exists, passive stainless carries a Wood's-class strike, and non-conductors are routed to metallisation first

workflow.description: State whether the metal is formed before or after plating and filter the family shortlist accordingly
workflow.artifact: forming order decision with filtered family shortlist
workflow.gate: the forming order is explicit and any plate-then-form choice records the wear-resistance trade and its disclosure

workflow.action: Choose the support baths and barrier class
workflow.description: Select the nickel, copper or palladium class by ductility, levelling and contact requirements, applying the nickel-release check for skin-contact items
workflow.gate: the barrier class, its ductility class and its thickness class are named with a product sheet referenced, and skin-contact items have a dated jurisdiction check

workflow.action: Select the gold family and the named commercial product
workflow.description: Convert the surviving shortlist into a specific product with its technical and safety data sheets and its compatible strike and replenisher
workflow.artifact: product selection with sheets on file
workflow.gate: a named product exists with current sheets, compatible components identified from those sheets, and no setpoint taken from memory or from a forum

workflow.action: Lay out the strike, build and colour architecture
workflow.description: Assign the bath roles this finish needs and place them in the room within the segregation rules
workflow.artifact: gold tank architecture with roles and positions
workflow.gate: every gold tank has exactly one stated role and a position that satisfies the acid and cyanide separation requirement

workflow.action: Commit the gold inventory and the upkeep plan
workflow.description: Compute the standing gold per tank from volume and concentration and name who keeps each tank analysed and logged
workflow.gate: each tank has a standing inventory figure derived from volume times concentration, a bath-life expectation and a named maintainer

workflow.description: Plate coupons of the job substrate in the worst geometry and check adhesion, colour against the reference, coverage and handling survival
workflow.artifact: dated qualification coupon set with results
workflow.gate: all four checks pass before any customer work enters the system, with results recorded and dated

workflow.action: Write the selection dossier and hand it off
workflow.description: Record the profile, family, product and sheet revision, architecture, readiness verdict, claim class, coupon evidence, rejected alternatives and residual risks
workflow.artifact: selection dossier handed to bath maintenance
workflow.gate: the dossier is complete including the claim-class check and the accepted residual risks, and the maintenance side has received it before production begins

dominance_rules.rule: Hazard-class readiness dominates technical fit, cost and deadline
dominance_rules.rationale: a chemistry the shop cannot store, ventilate, train for or lawfully hold is not a cheaper option, it is an unavailable one, and the failure mode is measured in lives rather than in rework
dominance_rules.trigger: any family is proposed whose readiness verdict is missing, conditional-without-the-conditions, or negative
dominance_rules.action: remove the family from the shortlist and choose an alternative family, subcontract the step, or decline the work

dominance_rules.rule: The acid and cyanide separation rule dominates every layout, storage and drainage convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: acidifying a cyanide-bearing solution liberates lethal gas, and this remains true of an acid gold bath built on a cyanide complex
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to co-locate, co-store, share trays or share a drain between cyanide-bearing and acid solutions
dominance_rules.action: reject the layout and rebuild it with physical and procedural segregation verified against the jurisdiction's rules and formal training

dominance_rules.rule: The specific product's data sheet dominates handbook ranges, remembered numbers and forum recipes
dominance_rules.rationale: families describe mechanisms while sheets describe the product actually in the tank, including its stabilisers, its compatible components and its declared envelope
dominance_rules.trigger: any setpoint, compatibility claim or replenishment statement offered without a sheet behind it
dominance_rules.action: treat the claim as unverified, obtain the sheet, and record any bench experience as calibration in the log rather than as an override

dominance_rules.rationale: representing a plated piece as solid gold, or a flash as a durable plate, is both a compliance exposure and the fastest way to destroy a bench's reputation
dominance_rules.trigger: any request for wording the selected system cannot physically or lawfully support
dominance_rules.action: offer the accurate description and the wear expectation in writing, or decline the order rather than supply the wording

dominance_rules.rule: Regulated obligation classes dominate cost and throughput
dominance_rules.rationale: nickel release, waste and discharge duties and marking rules bind whatever the schedule says, and each is verified locally rather than assumed
dominance_rules.trigger: a cheaper or faster configuration is proposed that has not been checked against the target market's current rules
dominance_rules.action: run the jurisdiction check, record it with its date, and adopt only a configuration that survives it

dominance_rules.rationale: no bath control can rescue a coating plated onto a surface that cannot hold it, and the bath itself is contaminated in the process
dominance_rules.trigger: a plan that puts gold or an acid electrolyte in contact with bare steel, passive stainless without a Wood's-class strike, or an unmetallised non-conductor
dominance_rules.action: insert the required strike and barrier, or reclassify the job as out of scope for the wet line

dominance_rules.rationale: a brittle deposit cracks at the bend whatever the schedule needs, and the cracks open corrosion and exposure paths through the coating
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposal to bend, rivet, size or set a part carrying a hardened gold or nickel-phosphorus stack
dominance_rules.action: reorder the process to form first, or change to a ductile family and disclose the reduced scratch resistance

dominance_rules.rationale: stripping and replating a finished customer piece costs more in gold, time and trust than a coupon ever does
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to run customer work through a system that has not passed its coupon checks
dominance_rules.action: plate the coupons first, and if the deadline cannot absorb it, renegotiate the date or decline the job

dominance_rules.rule: Commercial products used per their sheets dominate any cost saving from self-formulation
dominance_rules.rationale: improvised chemistry has no sheet, no compatibility statement, no hazard classification and no supplier support, which turns every later problem into an unresolvable one
dominance_rules.trigger: any suggestion of mixing a bath from raw salts or of extending a bath with non-system additions
dominance_rules.action: reject the suggestion and source the commercial product with its sheet

dominance_rules.rule: The wear class the duty demands dominates a customer's finish preference when the two collide
dominance_rules.rationale: a coating that cannot survive the item's daily life fails visibly and returns, and the plater carries the blame regardless of who chose the finish
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer requests a finish class below what their described use requires
dominance_rules.action: state the mismatch, offer the class that fits, and if the customer insists, record the wear expectation and the decision in writing before proceeding

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the hazard-class readiness gate before shortlisting any family
anti_rework_rules.prevents: designing a whole process, and sometimes buying chemistry, around a family the shop turns out not to be permitted or equipped to run

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle the wear class and the forming order before choosing hardness
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a hardened-gold selection that crazes at the first bend and forces a complete strip and replate of the batch

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the colour reference and its viewing conditions before plating anything
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a batch accepted as close enough that fails comparison at delivery and has to be stripped and rerun

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the substrate class and its required barrier before ordering gold chemistry
anti_rework_rules.prevents: buying a bath the substrate cannot accept and discovering it as peeling, staining or bath contamination

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain the technical and safety data sheets before the drum arrives
anti_rework_rules.prevents: finding out after purchase that the strike, replenisher, anode or filtration in the shop is incompatible with the product bought

anti_rework_rules.rule: Check the claim class and the target market's rules before writing any customer-facing description
anti_rework_rules.prevents: relabelling, repackaging or a compliance retrofit after the goods are finished and sometimes already shipped

anti_rework_rules.rule: Apply the nickel-release and skin-contact check before specifying the barrier
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-stacking the entire underplate and re-qualifying colour after the line is already in production

anti_rework_rules.rule: Plan the standing gold inventory and the maintenance capacity before adding a second gold system
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a new tank that starves the existing baths of analysis attention and quietly degrades every job that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Qualify on coupons of the job substrate and worst geometry before any customer work
anti_rework_rules.prevents: stripping and replating a finished, sometimes irreplaceable, customer piece

iteration_protocol.trigger: a qualification coupon fails on adhesion, colour, coverage or handling survival
iteration_protocol.action: return to the family, product and support-stack decisions rather than to parameter tinkering, since parameters belong to the maintenance knowledge base and a failed coupon usually indicts the selection

iteration_protocol.trigger: the supplier reformulates, renames or discontinues a qualified product
iteration_protocol.action: obtain the new sheet, re-check strike and replenisher compatibility, re-qualify on coupons, and update the dossier with the new revision before customer work resumes

iteration_protocol.trigger: the shop's readiness state changes, whether through training lapse, staff change, ventilation failure or a jurisdiction rule revision
iteration_protocol.action: suspend the affected families immediately, re-run the readiness verdict, and re-select for any job whose family is now unavailable

iteration_protocol.trigger: the customer changes the wear class, the forming order or the intended market mid-job
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the family shortlist against the changed profile and requote rather than absorbing the change into the existing plan

iteration_protocol.trigger: a marking, nickel-release or discharge rule changes in a market the shop sells into
iteration_protocol.action: re-check that the selected stack and the claim wording still hold in that market, record the check with its date, and re-stack or re-word where they do not

iteration_protocol.trigger: wear complaints or returns cluster on one product line
iteration_protocol.action: revisit the wear class assignment and the bath architecture that served it before assuming a bath control problem, since a mis-selected class cannot be fixed by better maintenance

iteration_protocol.trigger: a second gold family or an additional colour bath is proposed for the bench
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the standing inventory, bath-life and maintenance-capacity arithmetic and the segregation layout before agreeing to the tank

iteration_protocol.trigger: colour drift keeps recurring on a hue that depends on an alloy addition or a hardener
iteration_protocol.action: reconsider whether the colour should come from purity instead of from an addition, which is a selection change rather than a control change

priority_rationale: The frame units come first because nothing downstream is meaningful until the job profile, the product-sheet doctrine and the hazard readiness verdict exist: they say what the piece must be, where the numbers come from, and which chemistries this shop may run at all. Wear class and colour target convert the profile into the two screening criteria the families are judged against, and only then do the family units and the support baths become choosable. Architecture, colour mechanism, substrate matching, forming order and rate follow, because each composes families and support baths into a stack for this specific piece. The commercial and regulatory units — standing gold inventory, claim class, nickel-release obligation and the referral boundary — constrain that stack against what the shop can sustain and what it may honestly say. Coupon qualification and the written dossier come last because they turn a decision into evidence and then into a handoff the bath-maintenance side can defend.
